title: Vacancies
lead: Vacancies published by companies. You can apply without a category: the company will see your contacts.

empty.title: No vacancies found
empty.text: Companies have not published vacancies for this specialization yet. Check back later or look at all specializations.
empty.filtered: Nothing matches the selected filters. Loosen or reset them.

drawer.privacy: Before you apply the company does not see your name or contacts. After applying it does, and you can revoke access in My applications.

apply.title: Apply for {{title}}?
apply.text: {{company}} will see your full name, email, phone, Telegram, about text, roles and soft skills. You can revoke access later: contacts close, the application stays.

applications.title: My applications
applications.lead: The company changes the status. An open application waits for a reply until the deadline.
applications.revokeText: {{company}} will no longer see your name and contacts. The application stays in the list marked as access revoked.
applications.emptyText: Apply for a vacancy and you will see what happens to it here: whether the company viewed it and how it replied.
